name: Vampire Hunter 2
source:
Under the golden moon he saw a vampire. Boiled blood commanded to destroy the beast. Then the gear of destiny began to turn mercilessly.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
金色的月亮下他看到了一个吸血鬼。沸腾的血液命令消灭野兽。然后命运的齿轮开始无情地转动。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
